ns2:section.sectionText: Academic Outreach restrictions and assessments apply, see http://www.outreach.uiuc.edu. This site-based course for students in the Rockford cohort begins August 23 and ends December 6. Class sessions will be held on Monday evenings from 6:00 to 8:50 PM at the College of Medicine in Rockford, IL. The building and room information will be provided once those details have been confirmed. The email address for the instructor is: wseerup@illinois.edu.
